title: Two Non-Cooks Try To Make A Vegan Grilled Cheese From Scratch
summary: In this Goodful video, host Rachel pits two inexperienced cooks, Ben and Tucker, against a no-recipe challenge to craft a vegan grilled cheese. The segment combines cooking instruction with humor and light game-show elements, introducing lifelines to guide the cooks (watch a 10-second clip, look up an ingredient definition, or consult Bona vegan). The vegan cheese is built from a cashew-carrot base, enriched with nutritional yeast, lemon juice, garlic powder, and turmeric, then thickened with tapioca starch and a structural agent (agar agar, with a nod to gelatin flakes). The mixture is formed on parchment, chilled to set, sliced into rectangles, and then toasted between buttered bread slices with a splash of water and a covered pan to melt. The final judging by a vegan panel, including Merle, compares appearance, texture, and taste, concluding with the reveal of which contestant’s cheese won. The video blends practical technique with playful commentary and audience-friendly tips.

sections.title: Introduction and Lifelines
sections.description: Rachel introduces the no-recipe vegan grilled cheese challenge with Ben and Tucker and explains the three lifelines (short video clip, ingredient definition, and Bona vegan reference).

sections.title: Cheese Base Prep (Cashew-Carrot Sauce)
concepts: Cashews and carrots boiled for softness
sections.description: Cashews and chopped carrots are boiled until fork-tender, then blended with the cooking liquid, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, turmeric, and other seasonings to form a smooth base.

sections.title: Formation and Chill of Cheese Base
sections.description: The blended mixture is transferred to a parchment-lined sheet, formed into a large rectangle, and placed in the fridge to chill and firm up before slicing.

sections.title: Grilling and Assembly
concepts: Pan grilling with water and lid to melt
sections.description: Sliced cheese is placed between buttered bread, then grilled with a splash of water and covered to encourage melting and browning of the crust.

sections.title: Judging and Reveal
concepts: Reveal of which contestant made which cheese
sections.description: Merle and the vegan panel judge the final plates, comparing presentation, texture, and flavor, followed by a reveal of which grilled cheese was made by whom.

sections.title: Closing and Call for Suggestions
sections.description: The host thanks viewers and invites comments on what Ben and Tucker should attempt next, with a brief sign-off.
